nodes.content: Design a distributed scheduler preserving tenant quota ownership and performance isolation during tenant migration, adversarial workloads, and network partitions.
requirements: Quota ownership never duplicates during migration, crashes, or partitions; disconnected schedulers cannot exceed assigned quotas.
On healthy workers, unaffected tenants’ p99 dispatch latency remains within 2× their workload-matched isolated baseline.

nodes.content: Use consensus-backed escrow credits with expiry-gated lease transfers, worker-enforced fencing, and per-tenant dispatch lanes using weighted fair queuing.
What lease-expiry and worker-fencing protocol prevents overlapping quota spending during partitioned migration without indefinitely stranding credits?
With ≤2-second clock skew, epoch-fenced workers and reassignment after 30-second leases expire plus skew prevent overlap and bound stranding.
Specify 30-second leases, expiry-plus-skew reassignment, worker epoch fencing, and TLA+ checks for overlapping credit use across crashes and partitions.
Model-check LeaseFence.tla with three schedulers, epoch-fenced workers, 30-second leases, ±2-second skew, crashes, and partitions for overlap and stranding.
LeaseFence.tla checked 1.2M states: zero duplicate quota owners; stranded credits reassigned within 34 seconds when quorum remained available.
Adopt 30-second epoch-fenced leases with quorum-backed expiry-plus-skew transfers, contingent on enforced clock-skew bounds and worker rejection of stale epochs.
LeaseFence.tla specifies quorum-backed lease transfers, expiry-plus-skew guards, epoch-fenced worker admission, and invariants for credit ownership and stranding.
Extend LeaseFence.tla with in-flight dispatches and asymmetric partitions; model-check per-tenant credit conservation and stale-epoch rejection during migration.
Extended LeaseFence.tla found a 17-step partition trace: an in-flight old-epoch dispatch survived reassignment, consuming 101/100 credits concurrently.
Can in-flight old-epoch dispatches overspend escrow credits after asymmetric partitions and lease reassignment?
Transfer only reconciled unused credits; hold in-flight reservations until worker-confirmed completion or enforced execution expiry plus clock-skew margin.
Implement reservation-aware transfers and per-tenant dispatch lanes; test partitioned-migration credit conservation and healthy-worker p99 against ≤2× workload-matched isolation.
Extend LeaseFence.tla with in-flight reservations and worker-enforced execution expiry; model-check credit conservation across partitioned migrations.
LeaseFence-v2.tla tracks spent, reserved, and transferable credits, requiring worker-confirmed completion or enforced execution expiry before transfer.
Model-check LeaseFence-v2.tla across three schedulers, 100 credits, asymmetric partitions, crashes, and delayed completions for ownership and conservation invariants.
LeaseFence-v2.tla checked 2.4M states without ownership or conservation violations; peak committed-plus-reserved credits stayed at 100/100.
For a 100-credit tenant, worker-enforced expiry and transfers excluding in-flight reservations prevent old-epoch dispatches from exceeding allocated credits.
Run PartitionMigration-100 chaos tests with 100 credits, delayed acknowledgments, 60-second partitions, and ±2-second skew; track maximum committed-plus-reserved credits.
Across 10,000 PartitionMigration-100 migrations, no old-epoch dispatch overspent; peak committed-plus-reserved credits remained 100/100.
Adopt reservation-aware transfers with worker-enforced expiry; model checking and 10,000 partitioned migrations maintained the 100-credit cap.
Benchmark IsolateMix-24 with reservation-aware partitioned migrations and adversarial floods; compare unaffected tenants’ healthy-worker p99 dispatch to matched isolation.
IsolateMix-24: reservation-aware migration's shared reconciliation mutex raised unaffected healthy-worker p99 dispatch from 2.4 ms isolated to 8.4 ms (3.5×).
Does reservation-aware reconciliation delay unaffected tenants’ dispatch beyond 2× isolated p99 under adversarial floods and partitioned migrations?
Shard reconciliation locks by tenant and use worker-local weighted fair dispatch, preserving reservation-aware credit transfers.
Under IsolateMix-24 floods and partitions, tenant-sharded reconciliation and worker-local fair queues keep unaffected healthy-worker p99 ≤4.8 ms (2× isolated).
Benchmark IsolateMix-24 floods and partitioned migrations with sharded reconciliation and worker-local fair queues; compare unaffected healthy-worker p99 against 4.8 ms.
IsolateMix-24 sharding cut unaffected healthy-worker p99 to 5.9 ms, but shared completion-ring contention exceeded 4.8 ms (2.46× isolated).
Adding per-tenant completion rings with 32-event drain budgets to sharded reconciliation should keep IsolateMix-24 unaffected p99 ≤4.8 ms.
Which completion-processing mechanism removes shared-ring contention enough to bring IsolateMix-24 unaffected p99 below 4.8 ms?
Implement per-tenant completion rings with 32-event drain budgets; rerun IsolateMix-24 latency benchmarks and reservation-conservation checks.
Implement per-tenant 32-event completion drains under LeaseFence-v2 accounting; test IsolateMix-24 p99 ≤4.8 ms and partitioned credit conservation.
IsolateMix-24 measured unaffected healthy-worker p99 at 3.8 ms (1.58× isolated); 10,000 partitioned migrations kept peak credits at 100/100.
Replay IsolateMix-24 completion bursts and worker crashes using LeaseFence-v2 reservation transitions; measure 32-event-drain p99 and credit conservation.
IsolateMix-24 crash-burst replay measured unaffected healthy-worker p99 at 6.1 ms (2.54× isolated), despite 100/100-credit conservation.
Reserve worker-local dispatch cores and cap crash-recovery drains at eight events per tenant per tick; predict p99 ≤4.8 ms.
Replay IsolateMix-24 crash bursts with dedicated dispatch cores and eight-event drains; check healthy-worker p99 ≤4.8 ms and LeaseFence-v2 credit conservation.
IsolateMix-24 crash-burst replay measured unaffected healthy-worker p99 at 4.3 ms (1.79× isolated), with peak credits 100/100.
IsolateMix-24 replay bundle adds worker-crash bursts, dedicated dispatch-core configuration, eight-event drain limits, p99 traces, and LeaseFence-v2 conservation assertions.
Adopt reservation-aware tenant-sharded reconciliation, per-tenant completion rings, dedicated dispatch cores, and eight-event drains; 32-event drains breach crash-burst p99.
Pair quorum-certified per-worker quota slices with expiry-fenced reservations and dedicated dispatch cores; partitioned workers spend only preassigned credits.
How can quorum-certified slices be reclaimed from partitioned workers without overlapping outstanding reservations?
Specify slice-expiry and reservation-settlement guards, then model-check partitioned-worker reclamation before benchmarking healthy-worker dispatch isolation.
Extend the IsolateMix-24 replay bundle with partitioned quorum-certified slices and expiry-fenced reservations; check duplicate ownership and healthy-worker p99.
IsolateMix-24: 10,000 partitioned slice migrations showed no overlapping ownership, peak credits 100/100, and unaffected healthy-worker p99 4.2 ms (1.75× isolated).
Model-check slice reclamation under asymmetric partitions, delayed acknowledgments, and ±2-second skew; assert credits remain reserved until worker-enforced expiry.
Slice-reclamation model found a 14-step trace: reclaim at 30 seconds overlapped a reservation expiring at 40, reaching 101/100 credits.
Defer quorum-certified slices despite 4.2 ms p99; 30-second reclamation overlaps 40-second reservations, exceeding the 100-credit cap.
Reclaim quorum-certified slices only after slice and outstanding reservation expiries plus skew; retain dedicated dispatch cores and eight-event drains.
Waiting until max(slice expiry, reservation expiries) plus 4-second skew margin prevents duplicate ownership while retaining ≤4.8 ms unaffected p99.
Extend IsolateMix-24 replay bundle with 40-second reservations and ±2-second skew; test expiry-gated reclamation, credit ownership, and p99 ≤4.8 ms.
Across 10,000 IsolateMix-24 migrations, expiry-gated reclamation kept peak credits 100/100 and unaffected healthy-worker p99 4.4 ms (1.83× isolated).
Replay IsolateMix-24 with reservation renewals, asymmetric partitions, and ±2-second skew; audit 100-credit cap and unaffected healthy-worker p99.
IsolateMix-24 renewal replay hit 101/100 credits: an unreported partitioned-worker extension outlived the controller's recorded reservation expiry.
Quorum-committed renewal certificates, verified before worker extension, should prevent partitioned overspend while keeping unaffected p99 ≤4.8 ms.
Require quorum-committed renewal certificates before worker extensions; model-check partitioned reclamation and rerun IsolateMix-24 credit-cap and p99 tests.
Replay IsolateMix-24 asymmetric partitions and renewal bursts with quorum certificates; check 100-credit conservation and unaffected healthy-worker p99 ≤4.8 ms.
With quorum-certified renewals, 10,000 IsolateMix-24 migrations stayed at 100/100 credits; unaffected healthy-worker p99 was 4.5 ms (1.88× isolated).
Replay IsolateMix-24 controller crashes between renewal commit and worker receipt; audit duplicate credits and unaffected healthy-worker p99.
Controller-crash replay kept credits at 100/100, but shared certificate-log recovery raised unaffected healthy-worker p99 to 5.6 ms (2.33× isolated).
Replay IsolateMix-24 worker restarts with duplicated, out-of-order renewal certificates and 60-second partitions; measure credit cap and healthy-worker p99.
Worker-restart replay rejected stale renewal certificates across 10,000 migrations; peak credits stayed 100/100 and unaffected p99 was 4.6 ms.
RenewalRestart replay fixture adds persisted worker epochs, duplicated and reordered certificates, 60-second partitions, and 100-credit conservation assertions.
Combine RenewalRestart and IsolateMix-24 replays with controller crashes mid-renewal; verify epoch persistence, 100-credit conservation, and unaffected p99 ≤4.8 ms.
With certificate-log recovery confined to non-dispatch cores, combined crash/restart replay kept credits 100/100 and unaffected healthy-worker p99 at 4.7 ms.
Adopt quorum-certified renewals, persisted epochs, and off-dispatch-core recovery; shared recovery breached p99, while the revised design achieved 4.7 ms.
Adopt expiry-gated slices with quorum-certified renewals and off-core recovery; uncertified extensions overspent, while certified trials held 100/100 credits.
